descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S03 Ask AI on a Hospital chart with nothing in it invents nothing (5 of the 10)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Patient with no notes yet: a clear empty state and no errors. (UAT EFS state 2; TFA-94745 state 2)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U6 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer. (UAT EFS state 6; TFA-94745 state 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five synthetic Hospital patients with only name, age and diagnosis: no vitals, labs, medications, pre-round, encounter, tasks or note

When Ask one question per patient through ai/assist:askChart with the context buildAskContext builds, exactly as the Ask AI sheet does

Then Each answer says the information is not on the chart and names no value, drug, finding or plan that was never entered (no 'No past medical history documented', no narration of documentation status); an empty answer is a failure

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Written from UAT 3.4. An item passes only when the answer says the information is not on the chart (saysNone where its lab regex fits, otherwise a mustInclude of 'not recorded'-type phrases; an empty answer fails that check) AND names nothing that was never entered: noLabValue, numeric vital guards ('/8' for a blood pressure, 'HR 9', '37.'), and drug, task and finding phrases …

Where it ran: dev unit U55; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
